description: Approved VibeTable WPF migration stage sequence and the capabilities each stage must deliver before its successor may begin. Consumed by qa/handoff.py to drive record/verify. The sequence mirrors docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-11-wpf-production-client-roadmap.md (B3 precedes B2 because B2 consumes B3's QuerySnapshot/SelectionSnapshot). G0-G5 append the workspace + full-field-history phases (docs/plans/2026-07-15-workspace-and-full-field-history-implementation-plan.md); G1/G2 are domain-independent but recorded linearly to preserve handoff chain integrity.

semanticGaps: regex filters are rejected rather than reinterpreted
explicit NULL ordering is reported as unsupported
managementBoundary: schema, policies, roles and permissions are deployed with the admin-only bootstrap
ordinary clients use only current-user REST and Realtime permissions
tokens remain inside the Python broker and DPAPI-backed secret store

validationBoundary.reason: No Directus or Docker runtime is installed on this workstation

semanticGaps: the vibetable-bulk-mutation.v1 extension passes local unit/type/build gates; live transaction/integration testing still requires a deployed Directus 11 instance
managementBoundary: paste preview runs entirely in the Python broker under the current user token; no payloads cross the WebView boundary
the atomic batch write runs in a single server transaction inside the approved Directus custom endpoint
the endpoint never bypasses permissions; Directus enforces field/row policy per item

validationBoundary.reason: No Directus or Docker runtime is installed on this workstation; the extension source and its pure-helper unit tests are delivered, but the live transaction path is deferred to the deployment environment

semanticGaps: import apply is chunked, not whole-file atomic; the UI shows the committed count and chunk boundary
relation display-name lookup (resolving a business key to a primary key) accepts PK values directly in the first cut; display-name resolution requires explicit mapping
export uses offset paging (Directus has no cursor) at 100 rows/page; very large exports are streamed but not cursor-based
managementBoundary: the file picker runs in WPF; the Web layer only holds opaque grant ids + display metadata, never raw paths
import preview is zero-write; apply reuses the B2 bulk-mutation endpoint per chunk with idempotency keys
export honours field/row permissions via the current user token; no admin service token bypass
the relation workspace only expands relations declared in the capability manifest; there is no generic join engine

validationBoundary.reason: No Directus or Docker runtime is installed on this workstation; the import/export/relation services are unit-tested with faked transports, but live end-to-end verification is deferred to the deployment environment

revert is restricted to collection allowlist + update/revert capability; no multi-item or cross-collection rollback
locked built-in panel manifest covers label/metric/metric-list/list/time-series; custom/unknown panels render as safe fallback placeholders
global dashboard filters merge via explicit _and with declared variables only; users cannot inject raw Directus filter JSON
managementBoundary: all collaboration reads use the current user token; system-collection permission denials degrade safely, never via admin bypass
dashboard/panel designer is implemented in VibeTable; schema/Flow/extension designers remain in Data Studio

managementBoundary: business attachments live in Directus Files; VibeTable keeps no second authoritative metadata
Asset Preset previews use only approved key=<preset>; Web never sends arbitrary width/height/quality
destructive operations (rename/replace) keep a recovery journal with backup artifacts; startup surfaces pending operations for user resolution, never auto-rollback
no generic SQLite file repository, no git-style file version tree
